_README: Label id -> structure name for the lower-limb bone volume of the Visible Human female (IDC series af18f5e4, femur-to-toes fresh CT, 0.72 mm) by scripts/cryo/vhf_legs_bones.py, plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Femurs come from the TotalSegmentator `total` task on the same block and are shipped from ct_vhf (torso block, proximal part) and here (whole); tibia and fibula are the two long HU>=200 components below the femur (the thinner is the fibula); the patella is the largest component anterior to the distal femur; the foot bones are grouped by planes along the foot axis from the heel (tarsals <115 mm, metatarsals 115-190, phalanges beyond). Registered to the torso block by the femoral-head sphere fits present in both scans.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female, via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 femur labels.
